nameEn: Manufacture of cement, lime and plaster
description: This class includes the manufacture of cement, lime and plaster.
includes: manufacture of clinkers and hydraulic cements, including Portland, aluminous, slag and supersulphate cements
manufacture of quicklime, slaked lime and hydraulic lime
manufacture of plasters of calcined gypsum or calcined sulphate
manufacture of refractory cements, mortars, concretes and similar compositions
excludes: manufacture of articles of cement, see 2395
manufacture of articles of plaster, see 2395
manufacture of refractory ceramic products, see 2391
